title: Private and Distributionally Robust Federated Multiclass Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.13631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fault diagnosis in asset-intensive industries requires multiclass models trained on noisy, sensitive data collected across geographically distributed client sites. Federated learning enables collaborative training without centralizing data, but most approaches do not provide formal privacy guarantees for individual records stored at client sites and can degrade under label noise. To address these limitations, we develop a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification that provides sample-level privacy for records stored at each client. We build on a federated Wasserstein distributionally robust multiclass objective with the Crammer-Singer loss, solved using an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. translated_title: 隐私保护与分布鲁棒的联邦多分类
translated_abstract: 资产密集型行业中的故障诊断需要在多个地理分布的客户端站点上采集的含噪、敏感数据来训练多分类模型。联邦学习能够在不集中数据的情况下实现协同训练，但大多数方法无法为存储在客户端的单条记录提供正式的隐私保证，并且在标签噪声下性能可能退化。为解决这些局限性，我们开发了一个差分隐私、分布鲁棒的联邦多分类框架，为存储在每个客户端的记录提供样本级隐私保护。我们基于带有Crammer-Singer损失的联邦Wasserstein分布鲁棒多分类目标函数，并使用基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的算法进行求解。为保护发布的客户端更新，我们的方法向本地模型以及（截断）的近端线性化客户端更新中注入经过校准的高斯噪声。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个差分隐私且分布鲁棒的联邦多分类框架，基于ADMM算法求解联邦Wasserstein分布鲁棒目标，并通过注入校准高斯噪声为客户端数据提供样本级隐私保护和对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification, which solves a federated Wasserstein robust objective with an ADMM-based algorithm and injects calibrated Gaussian noise to provide sample-level privacy at each client and robustness to label noise.
